scope.deliverable: Live feasibility and implementation architecture plan
scope.notes: This document describes how to implement the selected Panic-Reversal Bot configuration later. It does not build or enable live execution.

required_endpoints.name: klines
required_endpoints.purpose: Fetch 15m OHLCV candles for all symbols.

required_endpoints.name: exchange_time
required_endpoints.purpose: Check clock drift and align polling to exchange time.

required_endpoints.name: exchange_info
required_endpoints.purpose: Validate symbols, trading status, precision, and quantity constraints.

required_endpoints.name: account
required_endpoints.purpose: Read equity, balances, and account exposure for later paper/live phases.

required_endpoints.name: position_risk
required_endpoints.purpose: Reconcile exchange positions against local state before live trading.

polling.completed_candle_rule: A 15m candle is complete only when exchange server time is greater than or equal to open_time + 15m and the following candle has started or the close can be confirmed by a later poll.

duplicate_prevention.action: Skip any signal or cycle already recorded in durable state.

data_quality_checks: Misaligned candle close sets across symbols.
Clock drift between host and Binance server.

calculation_order: Fetch and validate the same completed event candle for all symbols.
Append completed candles to local candle store.
Compute close-to-close event return for each symbol.
Compute prior-only realized volatility using candles strictly before the event candle.
Compute prior-only realized volatility regime threshold from history ending before the event candle.
Compute BTC 24h return ending at the event candle close.
Compute EMA50 and EMA200 values and slopes as of the event candle close.
Compute breadth count as the number of tracked symbols with event return <= -2% on the same event candle timestamp.
Select candidate long events where return <= -3%, realized volatility is in the high regime, breadth >= 4, BTC 24h return < 0, EMA50 slope < 0, and EMA200 slope < 0.
If accepted candidates exceed available caps, sort by largest drop magnitude and take only candidates that fit risk limits.
Record accepted, skipped, and duplicate signals with deterministic reasons.

realized_volatility.implementation_rule: Shift realized-volatility features and regime thresholds by one completed candle before evaluating the event candle.

timeline.description: Event candle closes. The bot fetches completed OHLCV and calculates signals.
No entry occurs. The next candle forms.
The bot confirms the next candle close, rechecks risk caps, then sends market entry orders for accepted signals.
Open positions are tracked as stacked fixed-allocation positions.
The bot sends market exit orders for positions reaching the scheduled pure_horizon_12 exit.

execution_timing.important_live_implication: next_close requires waiting one full 15m candle after the signal candle closes before entering.

allocation.quantity_basis: available account equity at entry decision time

recommended_pause_conditions: Daily realized plus unrealized loss exceeds configured threshold.
Exchange reconciliation differs from local open-position state.
Data for any required symbol is stale or missing at decision time.
Binance server clock drift exceeds tolerance.
Observed spread or slippage exceeds configured threshold.
Order rejection or partial-fill handling cannot resolve state deterministically.

cluster_stress_mode.action: Use stricter slippage assumptions, optionally pause entries if effective execution cost exceeds allowed threshold.

restart_requirements: Reload open positions and pending exits.
Reconcile with Binance account and position endpoints before any new order action.
Resume scheduled exits without duplicating entries.

failure_modes.mitigation: Retry with backoff; skip new entries when data cannot be confirmed; preserve pending exits for manual or later automated handling.
Poll again after a short delay; require all symbols to share the same completed candle timestamp before breadth calculation.
Use durable processed keys before creating entries or order intents.
Persist all pending/open state and reconcile before resuming scheduler actions.
Record actual fill quantity and price; adjust scheduled exit quantity to actual filled size.
Mark order intent failed, pause symbol if needed, and do not assume exposure exists.
Allow only if it maps to known stacked position state and symbol cap permits it; otherwise pause and reconcile.
Remove symbol from live universe only through explicit config change; skip entries while status is not TRADING.
Activate cluster stress checks and pause entries if effective cost exceeds threshold.
Compare host time with /fapi/v1/time before decision cycles; pause if drift is outside tolerance.

implementation_phases.name: Architecture and config freeze
implementation_phases.goal: Convert this plan into versioned config and module contracts.

implementation_phases.name: Dry-run signal logging
implementation_phases.goal: Poll live candles and log accepted/skipped signals without account access.

implementation_phases.name: Read-only Binance diagnostics
implementation_phases.goal: Validate server time, exchange info, balances, and reconciliation behavior.

implementation_phases.name: Simulated orders
implementation_phases.goal: Create order intents, simulated fills, scheduled exits, and full audit logs.

implementation_phases.name: Paper trading for production-like event count
implementation_phases.goal: Run through at least 50 accepted events or 30 days, whichever takes longer.

implementation_phases.name: Small-capital live pilot
implementation_phases.goal: Use reduced allocation and strict pause rules after paper-mode go criteria are met.

code_modules.data_fetcher: Fetch and validate Binance 15m candles, server time, and symbol metadata.
code_modules.signal_engine: Compute event returns, breadth, BTC 24h return, EMA slopes, and prior-only realized-volatility regime.
code_modules.risk_engine: Apply allocation, exposure caps, symbol caps, pause rules, and cluster stress checks.
code_modules.position_manager: Manage accepted signals, pending entries, stacked open positions, scheduled exits, and closed trades.
code_modules.execution_client: Abstract order placement; starts with no-op and paper clients before Binance live adapter.
code_modules.state_store: Persist candles, processed keys, signals, positions, order intents, fills, config versions, and logs.
code_modules.scheduler: Run candle-close polling, entry-due checks, exit-due checks, reconciliation, and report jobs.
code_modules.reporting: Produce dry-run/live diagnostics, skipped signal reports, exposure reports, and trade ledgers.

paper_mode_go: No duplicate signals or duplicate order intents across restarts.
Live dry-run signal counts match a replay backtest for the same period.
All accepted and skipped signals include deterministic reason codes.
Scheduled exits fire exactly 12 completed 15m candles after simulated entry.
Exchange time drift, stale data, and missing candles trigger pauses.
State can be rebuilt and reconciled after restart.
small_live_pilot_go: Paper trading covers at least 50 accepted events or 30 calendar days.
Observed next_close entry delay and slippage stay within configured assumptions.
Exposure never exceeds the configured emergency cap.
Manual emergency stop and pause controls are tested.
Small pilot starts below the selected 2% allocation until operational behavior is proven.
no_go_conditions: Any duplicate live order risk remains.
Candle alignment across symbols is unreliable.
Backtest/live replay mismatch cannot be explained.
Partial fills or rejected orders leave ambiguous position state.
Observed execution costs materially exceed stress assumptions.
